mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN analysis_task st ON st.id = ( SELECT st0.id FROM analysis_task st0 WHERE st0.case_id = c.id AND st0.task_type = 'VESSEL_SEGMENTATION' ORDER BY st0.updated_at DESC, st0.id DESC LIMIT 1 )

LEFT JOIN analysis_result ar ON ar.task_id = st.id LEFT JOIN analysis_review rv ON rv.result_id = ar.id LEFT JOIN analysis_report sr ON sr.id = ( SELECT sr0.id FROM analysis_report sr0 WHERE sr0.result_id = ar.id AND sr0.status = 'SIGNED' ORDER BY sr0.signed_at DESC, sr0.id DESC LIMIT 1 )

WHERE c.assigned_doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND c.status != 'DELETED'
AND c.workflow_status = #{criteria.workflowStatus}
AND c.eye_side = #{criteria.eyeSide}
AND c.updated_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND c.updated_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND c.updated_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
AND st.id IS NULL
AND (st.id IS NULL OR st.status IN ('CREATED','WAITING','RUNNING','RETRYING','FAILED'))
AND st.status IN ('CREATED','WAITING','RUNNING','RETRYING')
AND st.status = 'FAILED' AND st.status = 'SUCCESS'
AND st.status = 'SUCCESS' AND (rv.id IS NULL OR rv.status IN ('PENDING','CHANGES_REQUESTED'))
AND rv.status = 'APPROVED' AND sr.id IS NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient_id) AS patientCount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS caseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN st.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unsegmentedCaseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN st.id IS NULL OR st.status IN ('CREATED','WAITING','RUNNING','RETRYING','FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incompleteSegmentationCaseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN st.status = 'SUCCESS' AND (rv.id IS NULL OR rv.status IN ('PENDING','CHANGES_REQUESTED')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingReviewCount, SUM(CASE WHEN rv.status = 'APPROVED' AND sr.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingReportCount FROM medical_case c
WHERE c.assigned_doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND c.status != 'DELETED'
mapper.sql: FROM analysis_task t JOIN medical_case c ON c.id = t.case_id JOIN patient_profile p ON p.id = c.patient_id

t.id AS taskId, t.task_no AS taskNo, c.id AS caseId, c.case_no AS caseNo, p.patient_no AS patientNo, t.task_type AS taskType, t.status AS status, t.retry_count AS retryCount, t.max_retry_count AS maxRetryCount, t.error_message AS errorSummary, t.submitted_at AS submittedAt, t.started_at AS startedAt, t.finished_at AS finishedAt, t.updated_at AS updatedAt

SELECT l.from_status AS fromStatus, l.to_status AS toStatus, l.message, l.operator_type AS operatorType, l.created_at AS createdAt FROM task_log l JOIN analysis_task t ON t.id = l.task_id JOIN medical_case c ON c.id = t.case_id WHERE c.assigned_doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND t.id = #{taskId} ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT 5
